parsed.rationale: Both participating records live under paths that are sample/example app entry points: `Shared/WXUI/Examples/WXUISampleApp/Sources/WXUISampleApp.swift` (in an `Examples/` subtree) and `Shared/PlayerHeaderView/PlayerHeaderViewApp/PlayerHeaderViewApp.swift` (a standalone preview/harness app for the `PlayerHeaderView` package). The `body` computed property on a SwiftUI `App` conformance is boilerplate mandated by the SwiftUI protocol — every app target must supply its own `body` returning its own root `Scene`. The structural identity here is coincidental protocol-conformance boilerplate, not a meaningful duplication opportunity. Extracting or sharing these would conflate two independent app targets that exist solely to host their respective UI components in isolation.
